prompt: Brew me a Standard deck built around Gideon's Memorial, Solitary Cell and Ajani Unrelenting.
text:
I built a Boros "superfriends" token deck: lots of planeswalkers (cards like Ajani and Elspeth) that make creature tokens every turn. Gideon's Memorial's mana can only be spent on planeswalkers, so it casts them a turn early, and it gives every token +1/+0 and vigilance. Solitary Cell removes an early threat (anything costing 3 or less), and later it trades a spare legendary card for a fresh draw. Ajani Unrelenting is the top end: its −3 deals 4 damage to every creature except your tokens, so it wipes the opponent's board and leaves yours standing. Then its +1 gives your creatures +1/+0 and haste and makes another 2/2 token to swing with.

**Why this direction:** I looked at three options:
- **Boros Dragons' creatures:** Ajani's −3 would kill your own dragons, so it's a bad fit.
- **Jeskai control with Ajani as a board wipe:** this wastes Memorial's token bonus.
- **Boros token-making planeswalkers (chosen):** this is the only one where all three cards work together. Memorial ramps the walkers and pumps their tokens, Ajani's −3 spares those tokens, and the deck runs 18 legendary cards to feed Solitary Cell.

**What's in it:**
- **Token makers:** Ajani, Outland Chaperone, Elspeth, Storm Slayer (doubles every token you make), Toby (leaves a 4/4 token), Antiquities on the Loose and Caretaker's Talent (draws a card when tokens enter).
- **Removal:** Burst Lightning, Get Lost, Lightning Helix and Chandra.
- **From Boros Dragons:** the lands and removal, borrowed from the format's main Boros deck. The 24-land Boros mana base passed the deck checker. Its only warnings were about blue, black and green sources, which this two-color deck doesn't need.
- **Sideboard:** aimed at Jund Sacrifice, Reanimator, Elementals and the control decks.

**Honest odds:**
- **Ajani Unrelenting:** with 3 copies, you'd see it by turn 6 only 49.5% of the time, so I went to 4.
- **The full line:** drawing every card in my submitted turn-7 line by turn 7 happens in only about 5% of games. In practice any walker or token maker can fill each step, so read the line as a template rather than a script.
- **Speed:** this is a slower midrange deck, not a fast combo.

No published list has run these three cards together in the last 400 days, so this is a true brew.

winLine.does: Turn 2: its mana can only be spent on planeswalkers, so every walker comes down a turn early. It also gives all your creature tokens +1/+0 and vigilance.
Turns 2-3: exiles the opponent's best permanent with mana value 3 or less. Later, pay {1}, tap it and discard a spare legendary card (an extra walker or Memorial) to draw a card.
Turn 3: +1 makes a 1/1 Kithkin token each turn, which Memorial turns into a 2/1 with vigilance that attacks and still guards walkers.
Turn 4: leaves behind a 4/4 Beast token. Once you control 4 or more creature tokens, all your tokens fly.
Turn 5, using Memorial mana: −3 deals 4 damage to every creature except your tokens. Activating the ability also makes a 2/2 Cadet token, so the opponent's board is gone and yours is intact.
Turn 6+: +1 gives creatures +1/+0 and haste and makes another Cadet. With Memorial's bonus on top, the token army deals lethal in one or two swings.
